collections.description: Guided first-run pipelines for getting started in WorkX.
A lean agent-executed delivery lifecycle: one self-verifying implement pipeline, optional specification pipelines, and optional review and verification gates.
Pipelines that write PRDs and feature specs, tech specs, test plans, and implementation plans, with the templates and guides they use.
The implement pipeline that builds a change, runs its checks, and records the result, with its Work Item and Delivery Record templates and the defect diagnosis guide.
Pipelines for review, extended verification, and spec sync, with the review findings template and code review guide.
Guidance shared across stages: the project development guide, the pipeline that adapts it to a repository, and the test strategy guide.
Opinionated hello-world starters for websites, web apps, APIs, and mobile apps.
Starters for a static site and a Next.js website, with their contracts.
The React and Vite web app starter, with its contract.
Starters for a Next.js full-stack app and a React app with a separate API, with their contracts.
Starters for a Node.js API and a Python API, with their contracts.
Starters for an Expo app and a Flutter app, with their contracts and the mobile standards.
Guidance shared across starters: web and API standards and the project development guide.
